agendaItems.title:
File No. ANX26-27315
Public hearing for a voluntary annexation from University Holdings Ltd and Utah Investments Properties LLC, to annex approximately .63 acres of unincorporated Hillsborough County in the general vicinity of 1860 East Fowler Avenue. (Motion adopting resolution to schedule said public hearing initiated by Maniscalco-Young on October 1, 2026)
 
Email from Taylor Bollt, Assistant City Attorney II, transmitting an ordinance for said agenda item. (To be R/F)(Title of said ordinance listed below)
 
(Ordinance being presented for first reading consideration) - Ordinance of the City of Tampa relating to the voluntary annexation to the City of Tampa, Florida, a Municipal Corporation existing under the laws of the State of Florida, of certain unincorporated tracts of land in the general vicinity of 1860 E Fowler Avenue, consisting of approximately .63 acres of land; annexing said property to the City of Tampa upon voluntary petition from the owner of such property; redefining and extending the boundary lines of the City of Tampa to include the annexed property; providing an effective date.

File No. E2026-8 CH 2
(Ordinance being presented for first reading consideration) - An ordinance relating to the government of the City of Tampa, Florida, submitting to the electors of the city a proposed amendment to the Revised Charter of the City of Tampa of 1975, as amended, to amend Section 2.04 to clarify that City Council may create and fill additional staff positions to assist City Council as long as the funds are allocated within City Council’s budget; removing the requirement for prior mayoral approval; providing an effective date.

(Substitute ordinance being presented for first reading consideration) - Ordinance relating to the Government of the City of Tampa, Florida, submitting to the electors of the City a proposed amendment to the revised charter of the City of Tampa of 1975, as amended, to amend section 2.04 to clarify that City Council may create and fill additional staff positions to assist City Council as long as the funds are allocated within City Council’s budget; removing the requirement for prior Mayoral approval; providing an effective date.

agendaItems.title:
File No. E2026-8 CH 6
(Ordinance being presented for first reading consideration) - An ordinance relating to the government of the City of Tampa, Florida; submitting to the electors of the City a proposed amendment to the Revised Charter of the City of Tampa of 1975, as amended, to amend Section 6.06 to remove obsolete language; clarify that a majority vote under said section requires no fewer than four members of City Council to increase or decrease salaries of officers of the City; provide that City Council may act under said section pursuant to resolution or ordinance; providing an effective date.
